seal.statement: Every src directory carries a generated INDEX.md (one line per file: its top JSDoc summary and its importer count from the canonical import graph) produced by one generator under scripts, scripts/generate-source-owner-index.js, whose --check mode prints the number of missing or stale indexes as its last stdout line and is wired into the static audit chain in the documentation-current shape; docs/steering/router.md rows that point at a source file point at its directory index instead; this quest moves no file, the directory cap is source-directory-file-cap.
